semantics: Component boundaries are fixed from the frozen human remediation adjudication.
A component_id is an edition-routing label, not a project_work_id and not a new source entity.
PRIMARY_SUCCESSOR_HINT records the human reviewer's wording only. It does not authorize reuse of the predecessor W identifier.
DETACH means detach from the erroneous predecessor target; it is not a temporal, language, genre, or fiction-scope exclusion.
EXCLUDE_APPARATUS is limited to material explicitly identified as catalogue/study/apparatus in the frozen human plan.
An LLM may route editions only to these fixed components or HOLD_UNRESOLVED; it may not invent new successor boundaries.
